from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import passthrough

    name="Njet",

        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood"),

    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import passthrough

# Binning 1: exclusive/inclusive jet multiplicity bins built from "JetGood"
njet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# Binning 2: b-jet multiplicity bins built from "BJetGood"
nbjet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# Cartesian combination of the two binnings: (4j,5j,6j) x (2b,3b)
categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[njet_multicut, nbjet_multicut],
    common_cats={"baseline": [passthrough]},
)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for cat_name in categories.categories:
        print(cat_name)
